title: The Gods Themselves
author: Isaac Asimov
summary: In three parts, a free energy source passed between our universe and a parallel one is hailed as a miracle, until a lone physicist warns it may carry a terrible cost. The middle section takes place among the aliens themselves.
readIf: you like science fiction built on a big physics idea and strange, truly alien beings.
skipIf: you want fast action and rounded human characters above ideas.
